notes: UI Skins map and CSS variables are active; anonymous A/B/A requests returned distinct Ruderalis/Skunk values without cross-host carryover.

All 22 eligible configs reference layout-section and match Runtime/Sync. The 276-check validator confirms 21 rendered ComponentLayout wrappers and the direct wiki-entry SDC template for node.wiki_entry.full, plus published-entity render arrays and default-layout access. Import was targeted after a Runtime snapshot; no entity data changed.
node.document.full and block_content.basic.default remain the two documented exclusions because their Layout Builder configuration loses content.
Dynamic page cache reports UNCACHEABLE for tested pages, so cache-hit variation remains DEFERRED even though sequential host rendering did not leak skins.

UI Patterns Field Group remains preexisting and BLOCKED_UPSTREAM for security/Drupal 12 assessment. UI Patterns CKEditor 5 remains preexisting but unused in this implementation; removal requires a separately authorized config operation.
The Runtime is Drupal 11.5.0-beta1; Drupal 12 compatibility cannot be inferred from a Drupal 11 runtime test.
Global config:status still reports unrelated drift; the 22 migrated Layout Builder display configurations match Sync after Runtime serialization normalization.

node.wiki_entry.full has a purpose-built Twig adapter that renders the wiki-entry SDC directly from access-checked fields; it bypasses the configured Layout Builder wrapper and is validated as a UI_SUITE_NATIVE adapter.
Wiki full browser acceptance is DEFERRED: anonymous GET returned 403 and the authenticated Firefox runner produced a blank document without title/main; the artifact was not counted as a pass.

The public Forum categories page now wraps its native grouped View output with views-display while retaining the forum-category row and native style. Runtime partial import changed only views.view.aculta_forum_categories after a config snapshot; anonymous HTTP 200 and 12 category cards remained, with one H1/main, zero horizontal scroll at five light widths and two dark widths, and keyboard-visible focus.
